name: manual_ecf446
claim: When a script compares sibling repositories by directory, linked worktrees sharing one Git common directory are alternate checkouts of the same authority, not independent mirror targets. Resolve and compare their common-directory paths, then skip same-repository worktrees rather than reporting divergence.

decisions.notes: A linked worktree was incorrectly scanned as an independent downstream repository, producing a false divergence result. Comparing Git common directories is more reliable than parsing worktree output or relying on path heuristics.

rationale: A linked worktree was incorrectly scanned as an independent downstream repository, producing a false divergence result. Comparing Git common directories is more reliable than parsing worktree output or relying on path heuristics.
